title: Cube framework / Explicit cube / Implied cube
slide_intent: Distinguish a construction framework from its visible expression so a system can vary without losing structure.
strategic_value: A cube that can be explicit or implied can give Channel 4 content worlds flexibility.
demonstration: Three labeled panels compare a wireframe cube, a visible room and a purple soft-form composition around the green 4.
practical_value: Decide how much of the underlying cube needs to remain visible in a particular world.

content_islands.name: Framework
content_islands.spec: Show the wireframe cube at left.

content_islands.name: Expression comparison
content_islands.spec: Place explicit-room and implied-cube examples to its right under their labels.

reference_purposes.Application: The labeled comparison teaches explicit and implied uses of the cube framework.
reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram says the square motif can be recessive or prominent to support a flexible canvas.

ingredient.name: Cube world
ingredient.application: Use an explicit room or an implied cube while retaining the underlying spatial idea.
ingredient.scope: The 2023 case study expressly allows the motif to be recessive or prominent; it supplies no dimensional construction specification.
